## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '…'
2. Click on '…'
3. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened (screenshots welcome — you can drag & drop images here).

## Environment

- App: web (PWA) / desktop app / `npm run dev`
- Version or release tag: (e.g. `desktop-v0.2.0`, or commit SHA)
- OS + browser: (e.g. Windows 11 + Edge, macOS + Safari, Android + Chrome)
- Cloud sync enabled? (yes/no — WebDAV provider, e.g. Nextcloud)
- Project involved: local only, or synced from another device?

## Additional context

Console logs, `.lore` export if relevant (remove any personal content first), anything else that helps.
